name: 新新公司南侧商店主楼临街外观候选

documentary_sources.title: 《上海名建筑志》“日新又新”的新新公司大楼（市第一食品商店）
documentary_sources.authority: 上海市地方志办公室公开地方志章节
claims: 主体位于黄浦区广西北路与贵州路之间、南京东路720号，原新新公司、后使用为市第一食品商店；东边先施公司是另一栋，东南对街永安，西距20余米大新公司。
1925年建成，1926年1月23日开业；因此建成年与开业年不可混为矛盾。
匈牙利商鸿达洋行设计，营造方记鸿宝建筑公司，另有联谊营造公司之说。
坐北朝南，占地4280平方米、建筑面积22030平方米、高30余米；钢筋混凝土框架、折衷主义。
全楼分两部分：南向南京路七层，地面至五层百货、六层办公室、顶层戏院/舞厅/音乐厅；后部延伸天津路，作新新旅馆，贵州路正门。
外貌以简洁直线条、方柱和长方形门窗为主，二楼水平腰线；1950年代开辟骑楼走廊，底层多入口，文字列4处侧门、3处角门。
六楼挑出沿周边长阳台，铁栏杆；这为层位文字约束，不提供测量标高与所有转角连通平面。
历史段记屋顶南侧中部原有两层空心方塔、1949年拆除，另记东北/西北尖顶塔楼；现代2013/2024/2025照片实见南中两层空心塔和临街角亭。恢复经过与其是否原塔原样均未取得依据。
not_provided: 精确高度或30余米的测量端点
逐层层高、完整测绘平面、面宽进深与窗柱间距
现状屋顶塔楼是否保留/复建及当前设备
后部旅馆与楼体的具体分界和各部实际层数
documentary_sources.rights: 仅事实摘要与链接可随原创资产说明发布；全文/JSON完整响应只保留私人研究缓存。

documentary_sources.title: 新新百貨公司
documentary_sources.rights: Wikipedia text CC BY-SA 4.0; only attributed factual summaries and response hashes published.
claims: Same 720 Nanjing East Road identity, 1925 building completion and 1926 company opening.
Front seven storeys, rear hotel to Tianjin Road; repeats 4280 square metres site and more than 30 metres height.
Lists different historic storey uses and dates arcade construction to the 1930s; official gazetteer instead says 1950s. These differences do not establish present geometry.

photos.name: 新新百货.JPG
photos.author: Livelikerw
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: South street facade and western corner/side front portion with pale straight piers, rectangular dark multi-pane windows and paired rectangular spandrel panels.
Continuous upper projecting balcony with dark metal railings, brackets and an inset gallery behind its columns.
Low chamfered corner pavilion and taller open two-tier central tower actually visible in this 2013 photograph.
Side returns recede out of view; this is not a complete rear-hotel or roof plan. Commercial panels obscure some side-front openings.

photos.name: Shanghai_First_Foodhall_20250501.jpg
photos.author: Suicasmo
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Main south facade, taken from southeast, shows five tiers of large rectangular window openings above the street level and below the upper gallery. Topmost window tier is shorter in appearance.
Tall shallow vertically grooved pilasters separate bays; paired framed rectangular spandrel panels repeat between tiers.
Deep projecting gallery floor has brackets; black open metal balustrades and inset pale square gallery posts.
Central two-stage open tower has broad flat overhangs; lower stage is wider, upper stage narrower. Modern signage and wires are transient and excluded.

photos.name: Shanghai_First_Food_Hall_(2024).jpg
photos.author: Chainwit.
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Southeast chamfered corner and long south front, with the eastern side return in perspective.
Corner upper gallery turns across the chamfer; low glazed/chamfered pavilion rises above the broad cornice.
Existing central open two-tier square tower is present in 2024, despite the historic text describing a 1949 removal.
At street level the central entrance has paired round columns and nearby rectangular arcade piers; no full roof/courtyard is visible.

photos.name: First_Foodhall_head_office-20220828.jpg
photos.author: Shwangtianyuan
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Near-frontal central south lower/middle facade allows comparison of square pier rhythm, dark rectangular window groups and paired framed panels.
Central entrance is a broad recessed opening behind paired round columns; ground arcade continues with square piers.
Frame cuts off most upper roof/towers and edges, so it is not evidence of full building dimensions.

photos.name: 2024-Apr_Shanghai_East_Nanjing_Road_morning_01.jpg
photos.author: Chainwit.
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Street context looking west along East Nanjing Road places the foodhall as its own north-side building, distinct from west and opposite neighbors.
South frontage arcade, repetitive window/spandrel panels and upper balcony are visible; trees, people and signs obscure local portions.
This shares its capture session and direction with morning2024b; it provides no rear-hotel/courtyard view.

photos.name: 2024-Apr_Shanghai_East_Nanjing_Road_morning_02.jpg
photos.author: Chainwit.
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Near-duplicate same-session westward street context of morning2024a, confirming the continuous upper balcony and recessed street arcade.
Ground entry and multiple window tiers can be recognized; no measured heights or rear-roof geometry are revealed.

photos.name: 2024-Apr_Shanghai_East_Nanjing_Road_morning_03.jpg
photos.author: Chainwit.
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Same-time near-duplicate framing of foodhall2024: south frontage, southeast chamfer, open central tower and corner pavilion.
Counted as a separate downloaded file, not as an independent survey or rear angle.

photos.name: Shanghai_(December_10,_2015)_-_127.jpg
photos.author: Another Believer
photos.review_method: view_image of the full original local JPEG by xinxin_reference
observed_features: Night close view of the south central facade shows framed panels, dark rectangular glazing, tall shallow pilasters and strong balcony brackets.
Entrance columns and arcade depth are visible; colored artificial illumination must not determine daylight wall color.
Roof and complete plan are outside frame.

scope.identity: 南京东路720号新新公司／上海市第一食品商店，独立于先施、老永安、新永安及大新公司。
scope.modeled_scope: 南侧商店主楼临街外观、南中两级空心方塔、南两切角亭与东西侧前段；局部进深约31米为作者为了限定可见范围所选的截断，不是实测南北分界。
scope.rear_scope: 北部至天津路的原新新旅馆、未见中庭/屋顶及真实前后连接尚未制作；主图保留剩余原始楼块。
scope.modeled_period: 以2013、2022、2024、2025年照片中共同外观为主要参考，2015夜景仅复核细部；不声称1925初建或2026精确现状。
scope.orientation: 主立面南向南京东路；贵州路在西，广西北路在东；北至天津路的旅馆是本轮未建范围。
exclusions: 北部旅馆、未知内天井、真实后部立面与屋顶。
邻近先施、大新、老永安、新永安。
室内、广播室、顶层真实内部布局、地下部分。
临时广告、旗帜、食品店标语、精确商标和屋顶现代设备。
scope.coordinate_scope_note: 约31米的南部展示进深最初以整源局部坐标 y≤−8米限定；这里的y属于原始整源坐标系，不是后来以已建南体质心重设的模型坐标。最终模型原点、平移、方位及截断坐标以footprint-review.json的最终模型框架为准；重基点不改变已选世界范围或照片事实。

author_estimates: 全部精确尺寸、逐层标高、墙厚、窗深、柱距及塔亭台阶。
南部展示进深约31米／局部北截线是作者限制建模范围的选择，不代表已证结构分界。
南主立面约13窗轴及照片未见侧段的处理。
主体屋顶约29.2米、南中塔约37.5米是解释性选择，文献仅为30余米且端点未知。
unmodeled_followup: 北部旅馆、未见后立面、屋顶与内天井；真实南北连接及分界待资料。
period_policy: Current photographed exterior candidate; not a reconstruction of the 1925 completion state. The historic tower removal and modern presence are both preserved as separate evidence.
